name: Hantu Air
description: Hantu Air ('water ghost') is the Malay/Indonesian name for an unseen inhabitant of rivers, lakes, swamps, and the sea in the animist traditions of Maritime Southeast Asia. It can be benevolent or malevolent depending on how humans treat the body of water it occupies.

aliases.name: Water Ghost / Spirit of the Water

origin: Maritime Southeast Asia, especially the Malay-speaking world: peninsular Malaysia, Indonesia, Brunei, Singapore, southern Thailand, and the broader Malay diaspora.
